question: Where was the world's first TV channel dedicated to human rights launched?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**UK**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The world's first TV channel dedicated to human rights was launched in London(UK) in mid-January 2019.
 
• The channel is run by the International Observatory of Human Rights (IOHR), a non-governmental organization based in London.
 
• The IOHR uses the netgem.tv interactive platform to run the channel.
 
• The IOHR's focus is on exposing human rights violations.
